requirements.quote: A stage file stamped for another issue is not posted; covered by a test that reproduces the stash-pop case.
`git stash pop` in a lane worktree is denied with a message naming the alternative.
Two sessions cannot commit to the same lane branch concurrently; covered by a test.
No session starts in, or continues in, a deleted worktree.
Over 7 days of AlterLab batches: zero FORGE:IMPLEMENTATION comments whose listed files are disjoint from the PR's files.
requirements.why: Measured over 7 days of production AlterLab batches after release; needs a registered post-deploy check.

requirements.quote: Stamp `.forge-lean/*` stage files with the issue number and contract hash; refuse to post a stage note whose stamp does not match the run, and re-read it after the builder's final turn.
Deny `git stash push|pop|apply|drop` in lane worktrees (list/show stay allowed), and tell the builder to use a WIP commit instead.
One writer per lane branch: a fix-up session waits for, or is run inside, the active session.
Remove a worktree only after its builder process group has exited.

deliverables.change: new pure helpers: stamp line build/parse/verify (issue number + contractHash)
tests incl. stash-pop case: a stage file stamped for another issue is rejected and not posted

wiring only (import+calls, hotspot: stay under +150 lines): readStage verifies stamp, re-read after builder final turn, branch lock around builder sessions, worktree-exists check before builder start/resume, teardown waits for builder pgid exit before worktree remove, lane env marker for the hook
builder prompt: write stamp header on stage files; use a WIP commit, never git stash
wiring only: deny git stash push|pop|apply|drop|save|clear in lane worktrees (list/show allowed), message names WIP commit
tests: stash pop denied in lane worktree with alternative named; list/show allowed
new per-branch writer lock in the shared git common dir (atomic create, pid liveness, stale takeover, wait/timeout)
tests: second acquirer cannot hold the same branch concurrently; released/stale lock can be taken
tests: stamp mismatch not posted; teardown waits for builder exit; no builder start in a deleted worktree
register check implementation-comment-file-overlap (7d: no FORGE:IMPLEMENTATION comment whose listed files are disjoint from its PR's files)

preserve.what: Main-checkout stash deny and git list/show allowance in bin/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs checkMainCheckoutMutation
Existing stage note posting (investigation/implementation comments) for correctly stamped or legacy-unstamped-from-result.json fallback in bin/lean/lean.mjs STAGES
Teardown checkpoint/salvage and ledger semantics (bin/lean/lean.mjs teardown, bin/lean/ledger.mjs)

decisions.choice: New logic in new modules stagestamp.mjs and branchlock.mjs; lean.mjs and pre-tool-use.mjs get wiring only
decisions.justification: Hotspot rule: lean.mjs 3283 lines, pre-tool-use.mjs 2079 lines (scripts/hotspots.sh); precedent quota.mjs in #5264

decisions.choice: Branch lock lives in the shared git common dir, not GitHub
decisions.justification: Stash and worktrees are host-local; a git-common-dir file is atomic and visible to every worktree of the repo; lanelock.mjs:20 covers only cross-host lease
